Compute an abundance index from an FLStock

Source: R/oem.R
index.Rd

Computes an abundance-at-age index from an FLStock object at a given survey timing, correcting stock numbers for the combined effect of fishing and natural mortality up to that point in the year.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'FLStock'
index(object, sel = catch.sel(object), ages = dimnames(sel)$age, timing = 0.5)

Arguments

object

An FLStock object from which to compute the index.

sel

Selectivity-at-age pattern to apply; defaults to catch.sel(object).

ages

Character vector of ages to include; defaults to all ages in sel.

timing

Fraction of the year at which the index is computed (0–1); defaults to 0.5 (mid-year).

Value

An FLQuant of abundance-at-age corrected for mortality up to timing and filtered to the selected ages.

See also

FLStock, survey

Author

The FLR Team

Examples

data(ple4)
index(ple4, timing=0.9)
